Tap the option you think is right.

Work it out on paper first. Then reveal the solution one step at a time.

Formula / idea Principal value branch of sin⁡−1\sin^{-1}sin−1 is [−π2,π2]\left[-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right][−2π​,2π​], and sin⁡−1(−x)=−sin⁡−1x\sin^{-1}(-x) = -\sin^{-1}xsin−1(−x)=−sin−1x.

    Use sin⁡−1(−x)=−sin⁡−1x\sin^{-1}(-x) = -\sin^{-1}xsin−1(−x)=−sin−1x.

    sin⁡−1(−12)=−sin⁡−1(12)\sin^{-1}\left(-\dfrac{1}{2}\right) = -\sin^{-1}\left(\dfrac{1}{2}\right)sin−1(−21​)=−sin−1(21​)sin⁡−1(−12)=−sin⁡−1(12)\displaystyle \sin^{-1}\left(-\dfrac{1}{2}\right) = -\sin^{-1}\left(\dfrac{1}{2}\right)sin−1(−21​)=−sin−1(21​)
  2. 2

    Since sin⁡π6=12\sin\frac{\pi}{6} = \frac{1}{2}sin6π​=21​ and π6\frac{\pi}{6}6π​ lies in the principal branch:

    −sin⁡−1(12)=−π6-\sin^{-1}\left(\dfrac{1}{2}\right) = -\dfrac{\pi}{6}−sin−1(21​)=−6π​−sin⁡−1(12)=−π6\displaystyle -\sin^{-1}\left(\dfrac{1}{2}\right) = -\dfrac{\pi}{6}−sin−1(21​)=−6π​

    −π6∈[−π2,π2]-\frac{\pi}{6} \in \left[-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right]−6π​∈[−2π​,2π​]

  3. 3

    Hence the correct option is (A).

Answer(A) −π6\displaystyle -\frac{\pi}{6}−6π​

    Use sin⁡(π−θ)=sin⁡θ\sin(\pi - \theta) = \sin\thetasin(π−θ)=sinθ.

    sin⁡3π5=sin⁡(π−3π5)=sin⁡2π5\sin\dfrac{3\pi}{5} = \sin\left(\pi - \dfrac{3\pi}{5}\right) = \sin\dfrac{2\pi}{5}sin53π​=sin(π−53π​)=sin52π​sin⁡3π5=sin⁡(π−3π5)=sin⁡2π5\displaystyle \sin\dfrac{3\pi}{5} = \sin\left(\pi - \dfrac{3\pi}{5}\right) = \sin\dfrac{2\pi}{5}sin53π​=sin(π−53π​)=sin52π​
